ja: 遂に5体目のMk-IIロボ“ドロロロボMk-II”登場。
ロボ形態からドリルマシン形態へ変形。
ロボに乗り込むドロロ兵長も手足が可動。
ドロロ兵長はロボのコクピットにもなるソーサーに乗せることが可能。
武器はドロロ刀、盾が付属。
en: Finally, the fifth Mk-II robot "Dorororobo Mk-II" appeared.
Transformed from Robo form to drill machine form.
Sergeant Dororo, who gets into the robot, also has movable limbs.
Sergeant Dororo can be placed on a saucer that can also be used as Robo's cockpit.
Weapons come with a Dororo sword and a shield.
